blurb: This control checks whether a recognised monitoring agent is running on the AIX system, matching process names against a fixed list covering the Zabbix, Nagios, Prometheus, njmon, collectd and Datadog agents. A monitoring agent is how problems on the machine get reported to staff automatically. If none of those is running, a failure or outage here may go unnoticed until someone checks by hand, which lengthens downtime; monitoring that is not on the list may still be in place.
